# Farzan & Farzan

Farzan & Farzan is a family CPA firm in Encino, California.
Karl Farzan opened the practice in 1986. His sons Josh and Aaron are CPAs.
The firm prepares and plans individual, business, trust, and estate taxes.
The firm helps with IRS audits, back taxes, liens, levies, and payment plans.
The firm keeps small business books, runs payroll, and compiles statements.
Aaron Farzan is a QuickBooks ProAdvisor who sets up and trains books.
The office is at 16000 Ventura Blvd., #500, Encino, CA 91436.
The phone is (310) 394-0231. The email is info@farzancpa.com.
The first ten minutes on the phone are free.
Call for service. Emails are returned during normal operating hours.
